definitions.gloss: soil quality; soil type; nature of the soil
definitions.explanation: The physical and chemical properties of soil, including its composition, texture, drainage, and fertility. Used in agriculture, construction, and earth sciences.

examples.japanese: この{畑|はたけ}は{土質|どしつ}がよい。
examples.english: This field has good soil quality.

examples.japanese: {建設|けんせつ}{前|まえ}に{土質|どしつ}{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: A soil survey was conducted before construction.

examples.japanese: {土質|どしつ}が{粘土質|ねんどしつ}の{場所|ばしょ}では{水|みず}はけが{悪|わる}く、{雨|あめ}の{後|あと}に{水|みず}たまりができやすい。
examples.english: In places where the soil is clayey, drainage is poor and puddles tend to form after rain.

notes:
A compound of {土|ど} (earth/soil) and {質|しつ} (quality/nature). Used in both agricultural and civil engineering contexts to describe the characteristics of soil at a given location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土質|どしつ}{調査|ちょうさ}: soil investigation; geotechnical survey
- {土質|どしつ}{試験|しけん}: soil test
- {土質|どしつ}{改良|かいりょう}: soil improvement
- {土質|どしつ}{工学|こうがく}: geotechnical engineering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {土壌|どじょう}: soil (broader term, often used in agriculture and environmental science)
- {地質|ちしつ}: geology; geological properties (focuses on rock and deeper earth layers, not just surface soil)
- {地盤|じばん}: ground; foundation (the structural quality of the ground for building)
